title: Control board fault
fullDescription: Indesit ovens display F01 when the main control board fails its self-check. Power cycle first; if persistent, replace the board.

title: Cavity sensor open
fullDescription: F02 indicates the cavity NTC is open. Replace the sensor.

title: Cavity sensor shorted
fullDescription: F03 indicates a shorted cavity NTC. Replace.

title: Door lock fault
fullDescription: F04 indicates the self-clean lock motor failed. Replace lock assembly.

title: Fan motor fault
fullDescription: F05 indicates convection fan tachometer below threshold.

title: Cooling fan fault
fullDescription: F06 indicates the cooling fan failed. Heat is locked out for cabinet protection.

title: Touch keypad fault
fullDescription: F07 occurs when a touch button is stuck. Clean and reset.

title: Mains voltage fault
fullDescription: F08 reports voltage drift outside operating spec.

title: Communication error
fullDescription: F09 indicates lost communication between display and main control.

title: Runaway temperature
fullDescription: F10 indicates the oven detected runaway temperature. Disconnect power and call service.
